instagram.caption:
The delicates bag that never fills.
The Sorting and Hamper Zone in the Laundry Room. Turn dirty clothes into loads that can go straight into the machine without being handled twice.

What done looks like:
1. Three labeled bags standing clear of the walking line
2. Each below half full
3. A small dish on the shelf holding nothing older than today
4. Bare floor in front of the washer door

Free written steps for this zone, no signup: link in bio, or search 6S Success sorting and hamper zone.
